subject: MAP: seed-suite access lane agreement and takedown timeline
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria@acme.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — seed-suite exchange

Stephanie — thanks for the quick call earlier. As discussed, Acme is ready to provide a limited seed suite (≈2k labeled items) for Redwood to run an evaluation, but legal needs explicit usage constraints and a takedown plan in the MAP before we can move the data. Key asks from our side: 1) data is for evaluation only (no production training or redistribution), 2) access timebox: 30 days post-ingest with a 7-day extension option, 3) audit logs and proof of deletion, and 4) limited user list (names below).

I'll attach the sample index and our proposed redlines. Can you confirm Redwood's acceptance and a proposed timeline (ingest date + deletion confirmation)?

— Maria
Acme AI — Director, Evaluation Programs

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — seed-suite exchange

Maria — thanks for sending. We can do the evaluation lane under the constraints you outlined; a few clarifying points from our side: 

- Redwood will treat the seed suite as evaluation-only: we will not use the dataset for service model training or redistribution.
- Standard access window: 30 days from the day the dataset is ingested into a sandboxed S3 bucket in our Private environment; we confirm deletion within 48 hours of the takedown date and provide an audit log (S3 deletion events + job run id).
- Extension option: +7 days, not to exceed 37 days total; extension requires an approved ticket from Acme's project lead.
- Users with access: Stephanie Nguyen, Ben Carter, and two named Acme reviewers (Maria + one guest).

I'll circulate a short MAP draft with milestones (ingest, smoke tests, acceptance evals, deletion confirmation) by end of day. Attaching a starting MAP (v1) and the seed sample index for Polaris team review.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@acme.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — seed-suite exchange

Maria — quick operational notes from infra: 

- We'll provision an ephemeral S3 bucket in the Acme Private workspace; access via short-lived credentials (STS) scoped to the bucket.
- Ingest plan: S3 PUT + checksum verification, then a snapshot of metadata stored in our audit index.
- Deletion proof: we will export the deletion job run (job-id + S3 event logs) and a generated hash manifest of removed files.
- We'll run the eval on a dedicated GPU pool with disabled caching to avoid retention risk.

If Acme legal is fine with the credential/exposure approach, we can set ingest for Sept 18 and begin the 30-day clock on Sept 19.

— Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Acme AI Legal <legal@acme.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria@acme.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP draft and redlines — required clarifications

Team — legal here. We appreciate the clarification. Two requested edits to Redwood's MAP v1 (attached as PDF): 

1) Stronger definition of "evaluation": add a clause explicitly prohibiting any model weight updates or parameter tuning that incorporate the dataset. Benchmarks/metrics are fine; reproducible logs required.
2) Deletion certification: we need an attestation letter on Redwood letterhead (signed) that references the job id and manifest, and confirmation that no backups or cold archives contain the data.

We also noticed the MAP references a possible 7-day extension; legal requires a written request with justification and a named approver at Acme (we suggest Maria).

Please update the MAP and provide the attestation template we can sign off on.

— Acme Legal

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@acme.ai>, Acme AI Legal <legal@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and redlines — updated MAP and attestation flow

Maria / Legal — attached: MAP_Acme_seed-suite_v1.pdf (updated) and a draft deletion attestation. Summary of updates: 

- "Evaluation" clause expanded: no training, fine-tuning, or parameter updates using seed suite artifacts; any offline reproduction of metrics must be performed on anonymized or synthetic copies and logged.
- Deletion attestation: draft included; once deletion job completes we will populate job id + manifest and provide a signed attestation within 48 hours. Redwood confirms we will: 1) purge S3 bucket, 2) remove snapshot metadata in our audit index, and 3) verify no archival copies exist in cold storage.
- Extension process: Maria to submit extension request in writing 7 days prior to expiry; Redwood's technical lead (Ben) will approve based on evaluation progress and risk review.

Next steps: Maria to confirm acceptance of updated MAP and provide preferred ingest date. Proposed ingest: 2025-09-19 morning. If accepted, Ben will send STS credentials and a short runbook for the ingest flow.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the MAP and starting the evaluation lane.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Acme_seed-suite_v1.pdf, seed_sample_index.csv, NDA_redline_acme.docx
